title: 介词短语与固定表达
description: in the wake of、at the expense of、by and large……阅读和写作中高频出现、无法逐字直译的固定表达。

entries.meaning: 在……之后（常指灾难、事件之后）
entries.example: In the wake of the storm, many roads were closed.
entries.translation: 暴风雨过后，许多道路被封闭。

entries.example: He built his career at the expense of his health.
entries.translation: 他以牺牲健康为代价成就了事业。

entries.example: I'm writing on behalf of the whole class.
entries.translation: 我代表全班同学写这封信。

entries.example: In terms of price, this phone is the best choice.
entries.translation: 就价格而言，这部手机是最佳选择。

entries.example: We went out in spite of the rain.
entries.translation: 尽管下着雨，我们还是出门了。

entries.example: Anyone can join, regardless of age.
entries.translation: 不论年龄大小，任何人都可以参加。

entries.example: In addition to English, she speaks French and German.
entries.translation: 除了英语，她还会说法语和德语。

entries.example: The flight was delayed as a result of the fog.
entries.translation: 由于大雾，航班延误了。

entries.example: Most members voted in favour of the plan.
entries.translation: 大多数成员投票支持这个计划。

entries.example: Who is in charge of the project?
entries.translation: 谁负责这个项目？

entries.example: In case of fire, use the stairs.
entries.translation: 万一发生火灾，请走楼梯。

entries.example: You can use honey in place of sugar.
entries.translation: 你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

entries.example: Let's walk instead of taking the bus.
entries.translation: 我们走路去吧，别坐公交了。

entries.example: The game was cancelled due to bad weather.
entries.translation: 由于天气不好，比赛取消了。

entries.example: Thanks to your help, we finished on time.
entries.translation: 多亏你的帮忙，我们按时完成了。

entries.example: According to the forecast, it will snow tomorrow.
entries.translation: 根据天气预报，明天会下雪。

entries.example: Apart from a few typos, your essay is excellent.
entries.translation: 除了几处笔误，你的文章写得很好。

entries.example: She arrived along with her two children.
entries.translation: 她带着两个孩子一起来了。

entries.example: They crossed the river by means of a small boat.
entries.translation: 他们借助一条小船渡过了河。

entries.example: We travelled to Rome by way of Paris.
entries.translation: 我们经巴黎去了罗马。

entries.example: He quit smoking for the sake of his children.
entries.translation: 他为了孩子戒了烟。

entries.example: The building was designed in accordance with safety rules.
entries.translation: 这栋楼是按照安全规范设计的。

entries.example: In contrast to her sister, she is very quiet.
entries.translation: 和她姐姐不同，她非常安静。

entries.example: Our house is small in comparison with theirs.
entries.translation: 跟他们家相比，我们的房子很小。

entries.example: The company lowered prices in response to complaints.
entries.translation: 公司降价以回应投诉。

entries.example: I cooked him dinner in return for his help.
entries.translation: 我做了顿晚饭，作为对他帮忙的回报。

entries.example: Many young people move to cities in search of work.
entries.translation: 许多年轻人到城市里找工作。

entries.example: She stayed calm in the face of danger.
entries.translation: 面对危险，她保持冷静。

entries.example: In the light of the new evidence, the case was reopened.
entries.translation: 鉴于新证据，此案被重新审理。

entries.example: The school closed on account of the snow.
entries.translation: 学校因为下雪停课了。

entries.example: Students are selected on the basis of their grades.
entries.translation: 学生按成绩选拔。

entries.example: With regard to your question, I will reply tomorrow.
entries.translation: 关于你的问题，我明天回复。

entries.example: The two plans differ with respect to cost.
entries.translation: 这两个方案在成本上有所不同。

entries.example: As for me, I prefer tea.
entries.translation: 至于我，我更喜欢喝茶。

entries.example: She plays the piano as well as the violin.
entries.translation: 她既会弹钢琴，也会拉小提琴。

entries.example: Please arrive ten minutes prior to the start.
entries.translation: 请在开始前十分钟到场。

entries.example: Salaries will rise in line with inflation.
entries.translation: 工资将随通胀同步上调。

entries.example: In the event of an emergency, call this number.
entries.translation: 如遇紧急情况，请拨打这个号码。

entries.example: The small boat was at the mercy of the waves.
entries.translation: 小船任凭海浪摆布。

entries.example: They won the war at the cost of many lives.
entries.translation: 他们以许多人的生命为代价赢得了战争。

entries.example: She got the job by virtue of her experience.
entries.translation: 她凭借经验得到了这份工作。

entries.example: The phone rang in the middle of the night.
entries.translation: 电话在半夜响了起来。

entries.example: At the end of the day, we were all exhausted.
entries.translation: 一天结束时，我们都筋疲力尽。

entries.example: We met at the beginning of the term.
entries.translation: 我们是在学期初认识的。

entries.example: On top of everything else, it started to rain.
entries.translation: 更糟的是，天还下起了雨。

entries.example: The fire was soon out of control.
entries.translation: 火势很快就失控了。

entries.example: This map is out of date.
entries.translation: 这张地图已经过时了。

entries.example: The lift is out of order again.
entries.translation: 电梯又坏了。

entries.example: Keep medicine out of reach of children.
entries.translation: 药品要放在儿童够不着的地方。

entries.example: Sorry, that size is out of stock.
entries.translation: 抱歉，那个尺码缺货了。

entries.example: Going out in this storm is out of the question.
entries.translation: 这么大的暴风雨，出门是不可能的。

entries.example: Don't worry; everything is under control.
entries.translation: 别担心，一切都在掌控之中。

entries.example: She works well under pressure.
entries.translation: 她在压力下也能把工作做好。

entries.example: A new bridge is under construction.
entries.translation: 一座新桥正在建设中。

entries.example: Many species are in danger because of climate change.
entries.translation: 由于气候变化，许多物种濒临危险。

entries.example: Please book your tickets in advance.
entries.translation: 请提前订票。

entries.example: In general, people here are very friendly.
entries.translation: 总的来说，这里的人都很友好。

entries.example: I love fruit, and mangoes in particular.
entries.translation: 我爱吃水果，尤其是芒果。

entries.example: He doesn't like speaking in public.
entries.translation: 他不喜欢在公众场合讲话。

entries.example: You must apply for a passport in person.
entries.translation: 申请护照必须本人到场。

entries.example: We arrived just in time for the show.
entries.translation: 我们正好赶上了演出。

entries.example: The train left on time.
entries.translation: 火车准时开出。

entries.example: I'm sure he broke the window on purpose.
entries.translation: 我肯定他是故意打破窗户的。

entries.example: I found the letter by accident.
entries.translation: 我偶然发现了那封信。

entries.example: We met by chance at a bookshop.
entries.translation: 我们在一家书店偶然相遇。

entries.example: She learned the poem by heart.
entries.translation: 她把那首诗背了下来。

entries.example: By and large, the trip was a success.
entries.translation: 总的来说，这次旅行很成功。

entries.example: It was love at first sight.
entries.translation: 那是一见钟情。

entries.example: It will take at least two hours.
entries.translation: 这至少要两个小时。

entries.example: The repair will cost fifty dollars at most.
entries.translation: 修理费最多五十美元。

entries.example: Come here at once!
entries.translation: 马上过来！

entries.example: The winners were chosen at random.
entries.translation: 获奖者是随机选出的。

entries.example: Children who don't sleep enough are at risk of poor health.
entries.translation: 睡眠不足的孩子有健康受损的风险。

entries.example: I was at a loss for words.
entries.translation: 我一时不知道说什么好。

entries.example: She always makes her guests feel at ease.
entries.translation: 她总能让客人感到自在。

entries.example: It isn't boring. On the contrary, it's fascinating.
entries.translation: 这一点也不无聊，恰恰相反，非常有意思。

entries.example: The job pays well; on the other hand, the hours are long.
entries.translation: 这份工作薪水不错，但另一方面，工作时间很长。

entries.example: On the whole, I enjoyed the course.
entries.translation: 总的来说，我挺喜欢这门课。

entries.example: I bought some bread on the way home.
entries.translation: 我在回家路上买了些面包。

entries.example: He was offered the job on the spot.
entries.translation: 他当场就被录用了。

entries.example: These shoes are on sale this week.
entries.translation: 这双鞋本周打折。

entries.example: Which doctor is on duty tonight?
entries.translation: 今晚哪位医生值班？

entries.example: On average, I sleep seven hours a night.
entries.translation: 我平均每晚睡七个小时。

entries.example: She left the country for good.
entries.translation: 她永远地离开了这个国家。

entries.example: I don't know for sure when he will come.
entries.translation: 我不确定他什么时候来。

entries.example: Some animals, for instance bats, sleep during the day.
entries.translation: 有些动物白天睡觉，比如蝙蝠。

entries.example: You can stay with us for the time being.
entries.translation: 你暂时可以住在我们家。

entries.example: We still meet for lunch from time to time.
entries.translation: 我们还会时不时一起吃午饭。

entries.example: All of a sudden, the lights went out.
entries.translation: 突然，灯全灭了。

entries.example: As a matter of fact, I've never been to London.
entries.translation: 事实上，我从没去过伦敦。

entries.example: As a rule, I don't drink coffee after six.
entries.translation: 我一般六点后不喝咖啡。

entries.example: He was late as usual.
entries.translation: 他像往常一样又迟到了。

entries.example: Please reply as soon as possible.
entries.translation: 请尽快回复。

entries.example: In other words, we need more time.
entries.translation: 换句话说，我们需要更多时间。

entries.example: Exercise will save you money in the long run.
entries.translation: 从长远来看，锻炼能帮你省钱。

entries.example: The doctor will be here soon. In the meantime, please wait here.
entries.translation: 医生马上就到，在此期间请在这里等候。

entries.example: The kids finished the pizza in no time.
entries.translation: 孩子们一下子就把比萨吃光了。

entries.example: He left in a hurry and forgot his phone.
entries.translation: 他走得匆忙，把手机落下了。

entries.example: In a way, losing the job was good for him.
entries.translation: 在某种程度上，丢了那份工作对他是件好事。

entries.example: The two brothers have little in common.
entries.translation: 这两兄弟没什么共同之处。

entries.example: She explained the plan in detail.
entries.translation: 她详细解释了这个计划。

entries.example: In fact, the test was easier than I expected.
entries.translation: 事实上，考试比我预想的容易。

entries.example: In short, we need a better strategy.
entries.translation: 简而言之，我们需要更好的策略。

entries.example: The students answered the questions in turn.
entries.translation: 学生们依次回答问题。

entries.example: They searched for the ring in vain.
entries.translation: 他们找那枚戒指，结果白费力气。

entries.example: The charity gives food to families in need.
entries.translation: 这家慈善机构给困难家庭提供食物。

entries.example: Please be quiet; an exam is in progress.
entries.translation: 请安静，考试正在进行。

entries.example: Is this jacket in stock in a larger size?
entries.translation: 这件夹克有大一号的现货吗？

entries.example: She swims every morning to stay in shape.
entries.translation: 她每天早上游泳以保持身材。

entries.example: The film left the audience in tears.
entries.translation: 这部电影让观众热泪盈眶。

entries.example: The company has been in trouble for years.
entries.translation: 这家公司多年来一直陷于困境。

entries.example: In the end, we decided to stay at home.
entries.translation: 最后，我们决定待在家里。

entries.example: Why did you agree to it in the first place?
entries.translation: 你当初为什么要答应？

entries.example: In a sense, we are all teachers.
entries.translation: 从某种意义上说，我们都是老师。

entries.example: This is in no way your fault.
entries.translation: 这绝对不是你的错。

entries.example: It's raining? In that case, let's take a taxi.
entries.translation: 下雨了？那我们打车吧。

entries.example: On the one hand, the city is exciting; on the other, it's expensive.
entries.translation: 一方面，城市很有活力；另一方面，生活成本很高。

entries.example: It rained on and off all day.
entries.translation: 雨断断续续下了一整天。

entries.example: They live on the edge of the forest.
entries.translation: 他们住在森林边上。

entries.example: The species is on the verge of extinction.
entries.translation: 这个物种濒临灭绝。

entries.example: There were two hundred passengers on board.
entries.translation: 机上有两百名乘客。

entries.example: We went to the park on foot.
entries.translation: 我们步行去了公园。

entries.example: The house next door was on fire.
entries.translation: 隔壁的房子着火了。

entries.example: The project is on hold until next year.
entries.translation: 这个项目暂时搁置到明年。

entries.example: The band spent six months on the road.
entries.translation: 乐队在外巡演了六个月。

entries.example: House prices are on the rise again.
entries.translation: 房价又在上涨了。

entries.example: He was out of breath after climbing the stairs.
entries.translation: 爬完楼梯，他上气不接下气。

entries.example: My uncle has been out of work since March.
entries.translation: 我叔叔从三月起就失业了。

entries.example: The plane soon flew out of sight.
entries.translation: 飞机很快就飞得看不见了。

entries.example: I felt out of place at the formal dinner.
entries.translation: 在那场正式晚宴上，我感到格格不入。

entries.example: I was under the impression that the meeting was cancelled.
entries.translation: 我还以为会议取消了。

entries.example: Repairs are already under way.
entries.translation: 维修工作已经在进行中。

entries.example: Her talent is beyond doubt.
entries.translation: 她的才华毋庸置疑。

entries.example: The delay was due to circumstances beyond our control.
entries.translation: 这次延误是由我们无法控制的情况造成的。

entries.example: Keep a torch within reach in case of a power cut.
entries.translation: 把手电筒放在手边，以防停电。

entries.example: She is without doubt the best player on the team.
entries.translation: 她无疑是队里最好的球员。

entries.example: They both started talking at the same time.
entries.translation: 他们俩同时开始说话。

entries.example: We must avoid another delay at all costs.
entries.translation: 我们必须不惜一切代价避免再次延误。

entries.example: At first, I didn't like the city.
entries.translation: 起初我并不喜欢这座城市。

entries.example: At last, the bus arrived.
entries.translation: 公交车终于来了。

entries.example: At present, she is working in Berlin.
entries.translation: 目前她在柏林工作。

entries.example: At times, the work can be very stressful.
entries.translation: 这份工作有时压力很大。

entries.example: Help is at hand.
entries.translation: 援助就在身边。

entries.example: I could tell at a glance that something was wrong.
entries.translation: 我一眼就看出有些不对劲。

entries.example: The concert was cancelled at short notice.
entries.translation: 音乐会临时取消了。

entries.example: I'm busy at the moment; can I call you back?
entries.translation: 我现在正忙，可以稍后回电吗？

entries.example: The task is by no means easy.
entries.translation: 这项任务一点也不容易。

entries.example: This is by far the best restaurant in town.
entries.translation: 这显然是城里最好的餐馆。

entries.example: By the way, have you seen my keys?
entries.translation: 顺便问一下，你看到我的钥匙了吗？

entries.example: These carpets are made by hand.
entries.translation: 这些地毯是手工织的。

entries.example: Let's sit here for a while.
entries.translation: 我们在这儿坐一会儿吧。

entries.example: Children can visit the museum for free.
entries.translation: 儿童可以免费参观博物馆。

entries.example: She whispered for fear of waking the baby.
entries.translation: 她小声说话，生怕吵醒宝宝。

entries.example: We had to rebuild the website from scratch.
entries.translation: 我们只好从头重建网站。

entries.example: From now on, I'll go to bed earlier.
entries.translation: 从现在起，我要早点睡觉。

entries.example: To some extent, I agree with you.
entries.translation: 在某种程度上，我同意你的看法。

entries.example: His speech was short and to the point.
entries.translation: 他的发言简短而切题。

entries.example: To our surprise, the shy boy won the speech contest.
entries.translation: 令我们惊讶的是，那个害羞的男孩赢了演讲比赛。

entries.example: Keep your software up to date.
entries.translation: 让你的软件保持最新。

entries.example: Up to now, we have received fifty applications.
entries.translation: 到目前为止，我们已收到五十份申请。

entries.example: Everyone came, with the exception of Tom.
entries.translation: 除了汤姆，大家都来了。

entries.example: With the help of a map, we found the hotel.
entries.translation: 借助地图，我们找到了旅馆。

entries.example: The bank is next to the post office.
entries.translation: 银行就在邮局旁边。

entries.example: Close to a hundred people attended the talk.
entries.translation: 将近一百人参加了讲座。

entries.example: The problem is far from solved.
entries.translation: 问题远没有解决。

entries.example: She likes outdoor sports such as hiking and cycling.
entries.translation: 她喜欢徒步、骑行这类户外运动。

entries.example: I'd prefer to walk rather than drive.
entries.translation: 我宁愿走路，也不想开车。

entries.example: He no longer lives here.
entries.translation: 他已经不住在这里了。

entries.example: You can borrow my bike as long as you return it today.
entries.translation: 只要你今天还，我的自行车就可以借给你。

entries.example: As far as I know, the shop opens at nine.
entries.translation: 据我所知，那家店九点开门。

entries.example: The country as a whole is getting richer.
entries.translation: 这个国家整体上越来越富裕。

entries.example: I prefer working in the morning, as opposed to late at night.
entries.translation: 我更喜欢上午工作，而不是熬夜。

entries.example: She went to work even though she was ill.
entries.translation: 尽管生病了，她还是去上班了。

entries.example: So far, the new system has worked well.
entries.translation: 到目前为止，新系统运行良好。

entries.example: Sooner or later, he will find out the truth.
entries.translation: 他迟早会知道真相的。

entries.example: The work is more or less finished.
entries.translation: 工作差不多完成了。

entries.example: We eat out once in a while.
entries.translation: 我们偶尔出去吃饭。

entries.example: He read the letter over and over again.
entries.translation: 他把那封信读了一遍又一遍。

entries.example: The guide explains the process step by step.
entries.translation: 这份指南一步步讲解了整个过程。

entries.example: Little by little, her English improved.
entries.translation: 她的英语一点点进步了。

entries.example: They walked side by side along the beach.
entries.translation: 他们并肩沿着海滩散步。

entries.example: He did the same job day after day.
entries.translation: 他日复一日做着同样的工作。

entries.example: I'd rather talk about this face to face.
entries.translation: 这件事我更想当面谈。

entries.example: First of all, let me introduce myself.
entries.translation: 首先，请允许我自我介绍一下。

entries.example: And last but not least, thank you all for coming.
entries.translation: 最后但同样重要的是，感谢各位的到来。

entries.example: Needless to say, we were very tired after the trip.
entries.translation: 不用说，旅行结束后我们都很累。

entries.example: To be honest, I didn't enjoy the film.
entries.translation: 说实话，我不喜欢那部电影。

entries.example: Generally speaking, the weather here is mild.
entries.translation: 一般来说，这里的气候很温和。

entries.example: In a word, the holiday was perfect.
entries.translation: 一句话，这个假期太完美了。

entries.example: The policy will benefit the economy in the long term.
entries.translation: 从长期来看，这项政策将有利于经济。

entries.example: In the short term, prices may rise.
entries.translation: 短期内价格可能上涨。
